items.source: This bean must be included in the application context of any application using the Spring MVC GroovyMarkupView for rendering. It exists purely for the purpose of configuring Groovy's Markup templates. It is not meant to be referenced by application components directly. It implements GroovyMarkupConfig to be found by GroovyMarkupView without depending on a bean name. Each DispatcherServlet can define its own GroovyMarkupConfigurer if desired.
items.translation: 此 Bean 必须包含在任何使用 Spring MVC GroovyMarkupView 进行渲染的应用程序的应用上下文中。它纯粹用于配置 Groovy 的 Markup 模板，不打算让应用程序组件直接引用它。它实现了 `GroovyMarkupConfig`，以便 `GroovyMarkupView` 可以在不依赖 Bean 名称的情况下找到它。每个 `DispatcherServlet` 可以根据需要定义自己的 `GroovyMarkupConfigurer`。

items.source: Note that resource caching is enabled by default in MarkupTemplateEngine. Use the TemplateConfiguration.setCacheTemplates(boolean) to configure that as necessary.
items.translation: 注意，资源缓存默认在 `MarkupTemplateEngine` 中已启用。如需配置，请使用 `TemplateConfiguration.setCacheTemplates(boolean)`。

items.source: The default implementation uses the Locale associated with the current request, as obtained through LocaleContextHolder, to find the template file. Effectively the locale configured at the engine level is ignored.
items.translation: 默认实现使用当前请求关联的 Locale（通过 LocaleContextHolder 获取）来查找模板文件。实际上，引擎级别配置的 locale 将被忽略。

items.source: Spring's Groovy Markup template support requires Groovy 2.3.1 or higher.
items.translation: Spring 的 Groovy Markup 模板支持需要 Groovy 2.3.1 或更高版本。

items.source:
Note that this engine instance has to be manually configured, since all
other bean properties of this configurer will be ignored.
items.translation: 注意，此引擎实例必须手动配置，因为该配置器的所有其他 Bean 属性将被忽略。

items.source: Set the Groovy Markup Template resource loader path(s) via a Spring resource location. Accepts multiple locations as a comma-separated list of paths. Standard URLs like "file:" and "classpath:" and pseudo URLs are supported as understood by Spring's ResourceLoader. Relative paths are allowed when running in an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 资源位置设置 Groovy Markup Template 资源加载器路径。接受多个位置，作为逗号分隔的路径列表。支持标准 URL（如"file:"和"classpath:"）以及 Spring 的ResourceLoader理解的伪 URL。在 ApplicationContext 中运行时允许使用相对路径。

items.translation: 为加载和编译模板时，创建一个供 Groovy 使用的父 ClassLoader。
